title: Double orthogonal complement for a nondegenerate symmetric form
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $V$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and $B:V\times V\to k$ a symmetric bilinear form (linear in each variable). Assume that $B$ is nondegenerate, meaning that $B(x,y)=0$ for every $y\in V$ implies $x=0$. For a subspace $W\subseteq V$ define $W^{\perp_B}=\{x\in V:B(w,x)=0\text{ for all }w\in W\}$. Then
$$(W^{\perp_B})^{\perp_B}=W.$$

source.place: Proof, last sentence: 'the derived algebra has zero orthogonal complement, and hence it is all of the Lie algebra'
